lines.en: Luca, I keep thinking about the accident. If the warning had been heard, it wouldn’t have happened.
lines.pt: Luca, não paro de pensar no acidente. Se o aviso tivesse sido ouvido, ele não teria acontecido.

lines.en: I agree. If the road had been repaired in time, the van wouldn’t have been damaged either.
lines.pt: Concordo. Se a rua tivesse sido consertada a tempo, a van também não teria sido danificada.

lines.en: The residents had complained for months. If their letters had been answered, a barrier would have been put up.
lines.pt: Os moradores reclamaram por meses. Se as cartas deles tivessem sido respondidas, uma barreira teria sido colocada.

lines.en: And if the cracks had been inspected properly, the danger might have been noticed much sooner.
lines.pt: E se as rachaduras tivessem sido inspecionadas direito, o perigo poderia ter sido percebido bem antes.

lines.en: Who should be blamed, though? The council, the contractor, or both? If I had been in charge, I would have acted faster.
lines.pt: Quem deveria levar a culpa, porém? A prefeitura, a empreiteira ou ambas? Se eu estivesse no comando, teria agido mais rápido.

lines.en: If the contractor had been paid on time, the work could have been finished before the winter.
lines.pt: Se a empreiteira tivesse sido paga em dia, a obra poderia ter sido concluída antes do inverno.

lines.en: Maybe. But if nobody had been injured, we wouldn’t be talking about it. Luckily the driver was only shaken.
lines.pt: Talvez. Mas se ninguém tivesse se ferido, não estaríamos falando disso. Por sorte o motorista só ficou abalado.

lines.en: True. If the street had been closed that morning, he would have been spared the shock completely.
lines.pt: Verdade. Se a rua tivesse sido fechada naquela manhã, ele teria sido poupado do susto por completo.

lines.en: There will be an investigation, I’m sure. If mistakes were made, they must be admitted publicly.
lines.pt: Haverá uma investigação, tenho certeza. Se erros foram cometidos, eles precisam ser admitidos publicamente.

lines.en: I hope lessons will be learned. If similar warnings had been taken seriously before, we would have avoided this.
lines.pt: Espero que lições sejam aprendidas. Se avisos parecidos tivessem sido levados a sério antes, teríamos evitado isso.

lines.en: Let’s sign the petition today. If enough voices are heard now, the next accident can be prevented.
lines.pt: Vamos assinar a petição hoje. Se vozes suficientes forem ouvidas agora, o próximo acidente poderá ser evitado.

facts.big: if + had been + pp, would have been + pp
facts.label: 3º condicional passivo
facts.sub: If the warning had been heard, it wouldn’t have happened. If the road had been repaired, the van wouldn’t have been damaged.

facts.label: se tivesse sido
facts.sub: Para um passado que não aconteceu: If the warning had been heard, it wouldn’t have happened. Na oração com if, use had been + particípio. É a base do 3º condicional passivo.

facts.label: teria sido
facts.sub: Na outra oração use would have been + particípio: A barrier would have been put up. Também might have been e could have been, quando o resultado é possível, não certo.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: The if clause uses had been + past participle.
We say “If the road was repaired, it would…” for the past.
items.why: For a past unreal, use had been repaired.

items.s: The result clause uses would have + pp.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: The if clause uses had been + past participle. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “If the road was repaired, it would…” for the past. → Falso (For a past unreal, use had been repaired.)
The result clause uses would have + pp. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: After the accident · 1/3
paragraphs: Cleo and Eva live on the same street in Leeds. Yesterday a van hit a hole in the road. Nobody was seriously hurt, but the damage is serious. The neighbours had warned the council many times. Cleo and Eva meet outside the repair site. They talk about what could have been avoided.

“Eva, I keep thinking about the accident. If the warning had been heard, it wouldn’t have happened.” says Cleo. “I agree. If the road had been repaired in time, the van wouldn’t have been damaged either.” says Eva. “The residents had complained for months. If their letters had been answered, a barrier would have been put up.” says Cleo.
